object.name: evi_algoverb
object.description: Relatively expensive algorithmic reverb with many tweekable parameters. The reverb is modular, with pre delay, early reflections and late reflections all controllable individually, as well as linear TPT SVF filters in both the feedback path and end of wet path. In gen~ alone (as opposed to the MSP abstraction <o>evi.algoverb~</o>) this is tricky to use as the damping and EQ coefficients are produced externally via the <o>evi_svf_eq_coeffs</o>.gendsp (or equivalent) abstraction, and some parameters are differently named to the MSP equivalents. However it can still be used in gen~ alone providing some plumbing work is done.

attributes.name: decay
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, represents RT60 decay time, higher values create longer decays.

attributes.name: drywet
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attributes.name: earlyDiffusion
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, amount of diffuseness in the early reflections.

attributes.name: earlySize
attributes.description: Set in dB, the relative size of the early reflections.

attributes.name: earlySymmetry
attributes.description: The symmetry of the early reflections. A stereo imager, negative values favour left, positive values favour right.

attributes.name: earlylate
attributes.description: Normalised 0..1, mix between the early reflections and the late reflections. If at 0 or 1 the opposite DSP is not computed.

attributes.name: earlylock
attributes.description: Hysterisis of the cpu-mute of the early diffusion if engaged. See 'evi.algoverb~' abstraction for details.
